verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general startup H-1B sponsorship content (eligibility, cost, timeline, startup pitfalls) and self-petitioning for EB-1A/NIW. Nothing documents a founder's own company petitioning for them: no beneficial-ownership rules, no board or employer-control arrangements, and no 2023+ USCIS founder guidance. The startup-sponsorship blog is adjacent but does not show founder-specific coverage, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
